title: Daluobo RAG Support
summary: Knowledge-base support with tenant isolation, cited streaming answers, fallback, and human handoff.
description: A production support application built with React, TypeScript, and Cloudflare. The workflow covers tenant-scoped retrieval, metadata validation, keyword fallback, source citations, model fallback, and low-confidence human handoff.

title: RapidSite
summary: A production website-delivery product with reusable industry templates, content intake, and Cloudflare deployment.
description: RapidSite helps small businesses launch a multilingual website quickly. The public product includes industry templates, pricing and process guidance, a content-submission path, responsive pages, and English/Chinese interface support.

title: TenderFit
summary: An explainable tender-discovery product for smaller UK suppliers, with free preview and email-first alerts.
description: TenderFit filters official UK tender opportunities against a supplier profile and presents fit reasons, risks, and source evidence. The live product includes a free preview, pricing, legal pages, and a clear next-action workflow.

title: PM Forge
summary: A 12-week product-management learning platform with lessons, templates, exercises, interviews, and progress tracking.
description: PM Forge turns a structured product-management curriculum into a repeatable learning workflow. The live application is protected by Cloudflare Access and includes weekly lessons, reusable templates, review criteria, interview practice, and progress tracking.

title: P4 Parking Reservation
summary: Customer web, mini program, API, and admin workflows for date inventory, pricing, orders, payments, and refunds.
description: A multi-client reservation platform delivered to a client's cloud environment. The work covered booking flows, date inventory, pricing plans, order and payment states, duplicate requests, refunds, database migration, deployment, and regression.

title: Wadang Workforce
summary: Registration, review, points, notifications, and permissions across a mini program, NestJS APIs, and Vue admin.
description: A workforce and project-collaboration platform spanning several clients. Critical writes use idempotency and state validation; field mappings, permission boundaries, and release behavior are checked through migration probes and critical-path regression.

title: Jingpai Commerce Platform
summary: Targeted improvements to entitlements, inventory, orders, session access, and signed agreement records.
description: Work on an existing commerce platform with legacy PHP, MySQL, Redis, H5, and admin surfaces. Changes were bounded to known workflows and verified with reproduction cases, SQL checks, target releases, and rollback preparation.
imageAlt: Signed agreement record in Jingpai commerce platform

title: Zhisheng Commerce Iteration
summary: Product search, homepage configuration, admin maintenance, and data checks across mini-program, Java, and Vue clients.
description: Commerce and UI iteration across an existing uni-app mini program, Java service, and Vue admin console. The work focused on configuration isolation, product queries, homepage components, API contracts, and MySQL data consistency.

title: Liulian Distribution Platform
summary: Customer, distribution, order, product, membership, content, and back-office flows for a durian brand platform.
description: A multi-surface distribution platform with customer H5, operations admin, products, SKUs, orders, after-sales, membership, files, growth records, and distribution workflows. Current production status should be confirmed before making public commercial claims.

title: Sanjiaozhou Operations Platform
summary: Order, refund, finance, companion-review, and operational risk workflows with automated acceptance checks.
description: A multi-client operations platform covering order flow, finance reconciliation, review queues, risk signals, and admin controls. The project has automated acceptance materials; external payment and production launch status should be confirmed separately.

title: EdgeKey Digital Shop
summary: A multilingual digital-product storefront with card-key delivery, email notifications, and order lookup.
description: A Vike-powered digital shop deployed on Cloudflare. The public work includes multilingual storefront UX, digital delivery, email notifications, order lookup, secure payment presentation, and deployment customization.

title: Daluobo API Relay
summary: An OpenAI-compatible API gateway that exposes multiple AI models behind one endpoint.
description: A public AI API relay with a unified endpoint, model catalog, pricing, console, access controls, usage accounting, and integration examples. The product is an infrastructure service rather than a client application.

title: TomGo Studio
summary: AI-native UI design, prototyping, code export, and publishing workspace with project history and quotas.
description: A React and Cloudflare application for AI-assisted interface design. The system includes project ownership, version history, editable canvas, model-backed generation, queued jobs, publishing, export, credits, and admin controls.

title: SellerKit AI
summary: Text and image generation, asset storage, async jobs, idempotent claims, retries, and failure states.
description: An AI content-generation workflow for commerce assets. Workers AI handles text and images; R2 stores output; Queues coordinate asynchronous jobs with idempotency and failure handling.

title: ReleaseGuard AI
summary: A browser-based release verification workflow with evidence capture, URL policy, and GitHub webhook boundaries.
description: A prototype for structured release checks and evidence capture. The workflow includes browser execution, reports, URL policy, and webhook integration; it is presented as an engineering prototype, not a mature autonomous agent.

title: Career Agent
summary: A job-search workflow prototype built around deterministic matching, explicit approvals, and idempotent actions.
description: A product experiment for organizing job discovery, matching, and application workflows. The main path remains rule-driven and approval-first; it is not an autonomous application bot.

title: CodeRelay
summary: A mobile-first remote gateway for Codex and AI coding agents.
description: A developer tool for reaching Codex and AI coding workflows from a mobile-first interface. It focuses on remote control and interaction rather than replacing the underlying coding agent.

title: Xianyu Super Butler
summary: A customized resale-operations toolkit for listing, fulfillment, reviews, and AI-assisted workflows.
description: A customized upstream tool focused on Xianyu seller operations. It demonstrates AI-assisted application customization and operational workflow work; upstream authorship and production results are not claimed.

title: AI Goofish Monitor
summary: A Playwright and AI monitoring workflow for multi-task marketplace discovery and analysis.
description: A customized marketplace-monitoring project with scheduled searches, analysis, and a management interface. It is included as a tool customization, not as an original upstream product.

title: Daily Stock Analysis
summary: A multi-market data and LLM analysis system with dashboards, news, and scheduled notifications.
description: A customized data-analysis workflow combining market feeds, news, dashboards, and scheduled reports. It is shown as a data-tool experiment; financial performance is not claimed.

title: WeChat Intelligence Hub
summary: A local-first WeChat intelligence workflow with CLI search, daily briefings, and opportunity tracking.
description: A customized local-first tool that combines searchable chat history, Codex skills, briefings, follow-ups, and opportunity tracking. It demonstrates agent-oriented information workflows.

title: Agent Vision Toolkit
summary: A visual toolkit for text-only coding agents: image Q&A, long-screenshot OCR, UI restoration, and GUI automation references.
description: A customized vision toolkit that gives text-only coding agents additional image workflows. It is presented as a tool experiment and integration layer.

title: Java Order Reliability Lab
summary: A clean-room Spring Boot lab for idempotency, concurrency, transaction boundaries, and state consistency.
description: A public engineering lab demonstrating how order workflows should handle retries, races, transaction boundaries, and invalid state transitions without exposing client code or data.

title: Aurora Audio Bars
summary: A Windows system-audio visualizer with real-time neon energy bars.
description: A C# desktop experiment that turns system audio into a real-time visual overlay. It is included as a smaller product/engineering experiment.

title: HelperX
summary: A desktop utility for academic-resource access support and subscription management.
description: A smaller utility project focused on client subscription management and resource-access workflows. It is included as a tool/UX experiment.
